description: Who controls the company, followed up the register. The people-with-significant-control chain followed company by company while the controller is a UK-registered company (up to five levels) - each company's name, number, status and insolvency flag, what each controller holds, where the register ends (a foreign parent, a listed company, a PSC statement), and any trouble above. Individuals counted, never named. 2 credits. Use this for who controls the company up the chain of parent companies; for directors' and PSCs' ID verification use idv_check (key needed).

company.description: A UK company number (8 characters, such as 00502851 or SC123456) is surest; a name also works and goes to the closest registered company, which the reply names. Use company_search first when a name could mean several companies.

name: ownership
title: Ownership Chain
